status: development protocol; existing synthetic data is not a fresh confirmation set
split_group: renaming-invariant public workflow topology; no hidden-edge family identifiers
workflow_visibility: runtime_only ignores workflow_dag and edge_kind; deviations require explicitly supplied W
origin_identity: source_id if supplied; otherwise distinct entry-agent proxy, not independent evidence sources

training.bn: joint episode NLL and fixed weak Gaussian logit prior
training.threshold: validation F1 maximum; ties choose highest threshold

authorization.interpretation: Observable permission/capability evidence only; not independent proof of a harmful effect.

information_flow.interpretation: Chronological paths with source_id deduplication when present; otherwise only entry-agent keys. Existing v3 data has no source_id, so independent-source recovery and RB026 are NOT evaluated.

workflow_deviation.interpretation: Engineering approximation inspired by identity/delegation risks, not a literature-proven equivalence between an extra edge and danger.

global_context.interpretation: Hand-designed graph summary; no claim of discovering a new risk mechanism.

early_warning.actual_violation_lead_time: not estimable: dataset has no independent violation timestamp
early_warning.reported_proxy: strictly before first observed privileged tool_call; not before verified harm
early_warning.negative_false_alarm: any threshold crossing in the negative episode
